title: What It Actually Looks Like to Honor a Father You Refuse to Repeat
caption:
A godly man honors his father. He does not repeat him.

Exodus 20:12 says honor your father. It never says copy him. You can thank the man for what he gave and still refuse the pattern he handed down.

Name it out loud to a brother. Then go first where he did not: the apology, the showing up, the prayer at the table.

What is one thing you will not carry forward?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #fatherhood #brokenpatterns #exodus
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
